title: Start here: a tour of Aarogyam
summary: The left menu, Today, search and Settings, in about two minutes.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.narration: Welcome to Aarogyam. This short tour shows you around the app. You can pause at any step, or switch to slides and go at your own pace.

steps.title: The left menu
steps.narration: On the left is your menu. Each icon opens one part of the clinic: patients, calendar, queue, billing and more. Point at an icon to see its name.

steps.title: Today at a glance
steps.narration: Today is your home screen. These cards show how many patients are booked, who is in the chair, and who is waiting.

steps.title: Next up and the day's list
steps.narration: Below the cards, the next patient is ready for you. Under that is the full list of today's appointments. Tap any row to open that patient.

steps.title: Search
steps.narration: Search finds a patient, a page or a bill. Tap it, or press Control and K on your keyboard, and start typing.

steps.title: Type a name
steps.narration: Type a name, a clinic number or a phone number. The matches appear as you type. Press Enter to open one.

steps.title: New appointment
steps.narration: This green button is always here. Tap it to book a new appointment from any page.

steps.title: Notifications
steps.narration: The bell shows what needs your attention, like new bookings and messages. The number is how many you have not read.

steps.title: Guides
steps.narration: This book icon opens Guides. Every main job in the clinic has a short guide like this one. Come back whenever you need a reminder.

steps.title: Settings
steps.narration: Settings is at the bottom. Your profile, the price list, and your team live here. That is the tour. Open the next guide when you are ready.
